title: Faceless AI-generated history YouTube channel (AdSense)

source.text: A faceless YouTube channel that posts AI-generated history videos and earns from AdSense. Launch country US, budget $500, 10 hours a week, goal side income, no special edge. Just go: do not ask questions.

customer: US YouTube viewers of long-form history videos (paid indirectly by advertisers)
solution: Faceless channel posting AI-generated history videos
assumptions: Channel starts in 2026-11 and cannot reach 4,000 watch hours before 2027-01-31, so the 8,000 h bar applies
Long-form videos (8-20 min), about 1 per week at 10 h/week
Opportunity cost of time valued at $15/h
RPM $6 per 1,000 views (midpoint of a vendor range)
unknowns: user skills in scripting, narration and editing
